document_semantics: Admit and structurally validate the complete original Document with evaluator.CompileDomainSnapshot; never prune, substitute a trusted hash, or relax legacy Compile. Retain original asset/timeline/track/clip indexes and canonical document identity. Caller inputs are borrowed immutable until CompileDomain returns.
failure_semantics: Nil context, cancellation, invalid inputs, limits, unsupported graph and unexpected panic return zero authority/results. Context checked through admission, binding and timeline loops and before publication; provider/context panic values are never formatted. Owned getters and immutable state support concurrent readers. Evaluation DSP ProfileV1 and legacy profiles/fixtures remain unchanged.
guard_semantics: Before provider IO or block allocation, check audio authority, selected timeline and exact half-open time membership even in silent gaps. Sample indexes and block first/count must be nonnegative and overflow-free. Check exact SampleClock start and exclusive block endpoint, not rounded ticks or last sample alone; endpoint may equal requested end. Zero blocks require their start strictly inside requested range and a valid clock/index. Limits bound all original input admission and block memory, not RSS or synchronous validation/canonicalization execution time.
receipt_semantics: Owned receipt binds original Document hash, sorted owned scope, normalized limits, fixed offered declaration, separate domain/evaluator/DSP descriptors and actual selected asset IDs/indexes, manifest fingerprints, resources, streams, decoder order and source profiles. Receipt hash omits the receipt_hash member entirely. Not provider attestation. No raw graph, evaluator, native retained struct pointer or snapshot escapes.
scope_semantics: Audio only; exact positive half-open requested range and complete enabled same-domain intersection checked by evaluator against a fixed trusted caller declaration of offered capabilities. Compile only selected clips and require only their distinct asset bindings; reject extra bindings. No visual capability is inferred or claimed.
supported_graph: V1 supports implicit direct master, exact mono/stereo or explicit channel matrix, clip gain/pan and their existing automation. Reject every Document AudioBus, selected rendering extension, and selected nonunit source/timeline duration ratio. Evaluator rejects every transition on the selected timeline. Unselected authored audio and all visual sources remain structurally validated but are not bound or rendered.
